Overview

Sequencing.com is on a mission to make advanced whole genome sequencing accessible and actionable for everyone. We’re a startup at the intersection of SaaS, eCommerce, and health tech - offering DNA testing kits, secure DNA data storage, and a growing marketplace of reports and proprietary AI tools that help people understand their genetic data. We’re looking for a customer-obsessed, data-savvy, and outcome-oriented Product Manager to bring structure to our roadmap and help us scale with purpose. This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility and strategic impact. You’ll be responsible for managing high-impact product initiatives across the platform, driving execution from discovery through delivery. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, demands excellence in execution, and leads with clarity and decisiveness. You must have a builder’s mentality and a proven track record of releasing successful consumer-facing products.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and Drive the Product Roadmap: Maintain and enforce a focused product roadmap across our core platform, ensuring clarity of scope, priority, and impact. Track all features, bugs, and enhancements across Engineering, Design, Bioinformatics, and Customer Success.
  • Lead Discovery & Customer Insight Work: Combine qualitative and quantitative approaches to deeply understand our customers. Actively engage with users through interviews, testing, and platform usage, while also analyzing product and behavioral data to uncover patterns, friction points, and opportunities. Use both first-hand insights and data-driven findings to anchor product direction in real customer needs and outcomes.
  • Define & Scope Features: Translate customer insights and company goals into actionable product plans with clear documentation, timelines, and success criteria. Ensure projects are aligned with what moves the needle.
  • Execution Leadership: Collaborate cross-functionally to scope, de-risk, and deliver high-quality features at startup speed. Push teams toward urgency and disciplined execution.
  • Documentation Ownership: Write and maintain detailed product specs, user flows, success metrics, and timelines in Confluence and Jira. Your documentation will be the single source of truth.
  • Jira & Process Stewardship: Own the ROAD Jira board, ensuring tickets are properly structured, linked, and prioritized. Proactively manage dependencies, identify blockers, and support delivery cadence.
  • Product Communication & Strategic Thinking: Be a direct, clear communicator who can articulate priorities and say ‘no’ when needed. Protect the product from scope creep, stakeholder appeasement, or feel-good but low-impact projects.
  • Align, but Don’t Please: Collaborate effectively with stakeholders while prioritizing product quality and outcomes over consensus or politics. Communicate hard decisions without soft-pedaling.
  • Contribute to Product Culture: Raise the bar for quality, execution, and decision-making in a fast-paced startup environment. Help instill clarity, urgency, and discipline in the way we build.

What We’re Looking For

  • Customer-obsessed: You always start with the user and are proactive about talking to them. You’ve used our platform - or would have - before applying.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, consumer subscription, or health tech.
  • Highly data-driven: You can track and act on business and user metrics and apply analytical rigor to prioritize effectively.
  • Proven track record of shipping and scaling consumer products, particularly subscription-based platforms.
  • Strategic mindset: You can connect high-level goals with actionable plans, and keep long-term vision front and center.
  • Mission-driven: You’re excited by the potential of genomics and motivated by real impact.
  • Exacting standards: You push for excellence and aren’t afraid to raise the bar.
  • Resilient to pushback: You don’t fold under pressure and remain firm when decisions are right.
  • Direct communicator: You value clarity over ambiguity and fairness over comfort.
  • Executional excellence: You have the organizational skills to juggle multiple initiatives while delivering results.
  • Builder’s mentality: You earn respect through work product, not charm, and lead through doing.
  • Respect without people-pleasing: You collaborate well but don’t need universal approval to drive results.

About Sequencing

Sequencing is powering the future of personalized health. We are the platform that transforms a person’s genome into a lifelong source of straightforward, actionable insights - for individuals, families, and healthcare professionals. By providing the application layer to your DNA, we turn complex genetic data into recurring value throughout every stage of life.

Our unique, clinical-grade Whole Genome Sequencing unlocks the most complete view of your DNA, screening for almost all known health conditions, traits, and medication responses - and translating that information into clear, actionable steps for managing health risks, optimizing wellness, and extending longevity.

As whole genome sequencing becomes a standard part of life, Sequencing is already the trusted platform where people safely store their DNA data - and will become the lifelong home for every genome on Earth.

We’re a fully remote, global team of innovators, scientists, and builders, united by a mission to make genomics accessible, actionable, and life-changing for everyone.

Proudly named GenomeWeb’s Best Place to Work in 2024, Sequencing is venture-backed and scaling rapidly to meet surging demand in the fast-growing personal genomics market.

If you’re excited to help redefine how the world thinks about health, join us in building the platform that brings every genome to life.

  • Fazer o gerenciamento do ponto dos integrantes dos processos de sua responsabilidade no sistema “Populis”;
  • Responsável por definir as prioridades dos trabalhos dos mecânicos kaizen, bem como prover recursos aos mesmos.

Desafios

  • Atingir os indicadores de segurança, qualidade, produção e custo;
  • Alcance do ticket total e by size;
  • Redução na geração do TMA, waste e scrap.

Responsabilidades por Resultados

  • Zero acidente; trabalhar com os Integrantes de produção a ação de prevenir acidente, garantindo a utilização de EPI´s requeridos nas áreas de trabalho (monitorando o uso de EPI’s conforme o normalizador);
  • Atingir meta de produção estipulada para o departamento, conforme ticket de produção.
  • Atingir meta de qualidade estipulada para o departamento/área.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais (Prática Padrão, Procedimento Interno, Documento de Qualidade, entre outros) e de segurança (7 regras de Segurança), principalmente:
  • 1ª Regra – LOTO: é obrigatório aplicação do LOTO quando for realizar atividades que requeiram bloqueios de fontes de energias conforme Procedimentos e Conspícuos de LOTO;
  • 2ª Regra – USO DE EPI’S: A utilização dos EPI´S básicos e específico é obrigatória quando do acesso a área operacional e conforme Normalizador de EPIs da área;
  • 3ª Regra – SEGUIR PROCEDIMENTOS: Executar apenas as atividades para à qual tenha sido capacitado e seguir todos os procedimentos conforme capacitação;
  • 4ª Regra – ATIVIDADES ESPECIAIS: Cumprir todas as regras de liberação e execução para atividades especiais: Altura, Espaço Confinado, Movimentação de Cargas, Elétrica e à Quente;
  • 5ª Regra – PROTEÇÕES E DISPOSITIVOS DE EMERGÊNCIA: Não opere uma máquina sem as proteções ou que tenha desabilitado a parada de emergência ou dispositivos de segurança – não burle dispositivos de segurança, nem obstrua ou danifique equipamentos de emergência;
  • 6ª Regra – OPERAÇÃO DE VEÍCULOS INDUSTRIAIS: Na condução dos veículos industriais é obrigatório obedecer às regras de segurança para a operação, conforme regras específicas;
  • 7ª Regra – PAINÉIS ELÉTRICOS: Não abrir painéis elétricos sem ser autorizado (formação, treinamento NR 10 e NFPA 70E). Apenas profissionais legalmente habilitados devem realizar atividades em elétricas.

Qualificações / Qualifications

  • Experiência Mínima: 02 anos de experiência como coordenador (Produção preferencialmente).
  • Formação: Superior completo (Engenharia, Administração, e áreas afins
  • Outros Cursos / Conhecimentos específicos / Habilidades: Pacote Office Avançado, Conhecimento e Habilidade com Power BI e Inglês Avançado.

title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta. A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Sobre a área de Design

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Como Senior Product Designer, você será peça-chave na criação de soluções centradas no usuário que traduzem problemas complexos em experiências intuitivas e funcionais.

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Ya viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

Temos diferentes frentes de atuação e, durante o processo, vamos buscar o melhor encaixe entre suas habilidades e os desafios da Lemon.

Experiência desejável

(não esperamos que você domine tudo valorizamos curiosidade e vontade de aprender)

  • Conhecimento em design comportamental e arquitetura da escolha;
  • Experiência na construção e evolução de Design Systems.

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dia de folga adicional próximo a feriados).

Leia aqui por favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & inclusão

title: Learning Coach
description:
Overview

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career. Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry. TripleTen is a remote-first organization, mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

Please submit all Resumes or CVs in English

What to Expect During the Application and Interview Process

  • Video Interview: As the second step, you’ll need to submit a short video interview where you\'ll answer four questions, with each response being 2 minutes or less. This will help us get to know you better.
  • Assessment Task: Next, you’ll complete a brief assessment, which will be the first step in the interview process, designed to help us evaluate some of the technical skills essential for this role. This assessment mirrors some of the common tasks you would be expected to perform in the role independently after your initial 2 weeks of training.
  • Interview with the Hiring Team: Candidates who successfully complete the first two stages will be invited to a final 30-45 minute interview with our hiring team. This interview is specifically designed to answer any questions you may still have about the position, and provide clarity on the day-to-day responsibilities. We will also cover a few behavioral based interview questions to assess culture and work style fit.

All stages of the process will be conducted in English.

What you will do

  • Build strong 1:1 relationships with assigned students
  • Proactively coach students on motivation, time management, and study strategies
  • Help students navigate barriers to success and refer at-risk learners for support
  • Track student progress and flag disengagement in Planhat
  • Participate in live events and sprint launches when assigned
  • Keep documentation up-to-date for all student interactions
  • Submit reports, metrics, and trends as requested by Program Lead
  • Collaborate with peers for shift coverage, cross-support, and best practices

Requirements

Schedule

  • Monday - Thursday 9:00 am - 5:00 pm (Any US Time Zone)
  • Friday 9:00 am - 4:00 pm (Any US Time Zone)
  • Maintain timely responses: within 2 hours during active windows
  • You’re fluent in English - our students are Americans, many of our team members are natives, so it’s necessary to speak fluently.
  • You’re a fast learner - we conduct a lot of experiments, often change our processes, it’s okay not to know something but it’s necessary to learn and adapt fast.
  • You’re careful with numbers and analytics (Excel, Notion, Miro) - a Learning Coach calculates some statistics and collects certain data manually. It requires patience and attention to numbers.
  • You love helping and caring about people - our Learning Coaches are always there to help our students, check up on their motivation and ask for their feedback.

Overview

Senior Specialist, B2B Content Strategist (Bangkok Based, relocation provided) – Bangkok, Thailand. This role is based in Bangkok and open to candidates worldwide with a relocation package.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

The Opportunity

Join Agoda’s B2B Marketing team as a Senior Specialist, B2B Content Marketing and help shape the voice of our brand for partners worldwide. We’re looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven content expert to craft, distribute, and manage impactful content across multiple platforms. Your work will engage our B2B audiences, elevate brand awareness, and drive real business results across our organization.

Role Overview

As a Senior Specialist, B2B Content Marketing, you will be responsible for the end-to-end content lifecycle: from ideation and creation to distribution and performance analysis. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across departments to develop a wide range of content (e.g. articles, emails, case studies, videos, social media posts) that resonates with our B2B partners. The ideal candidate will be an excellent writer and strong communicator with strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Development and Management: Create, distribute and manage useful and engaging content to attract, engage and retain our B2B partners.
  • Website Management: Manage and maintain PartnerHub and RocketTravel, our partner websites, collaborating with brand, vendors, and business units to create, update and manage web content.
  • Project and Stakeholder Management: Lead and coordinate cross-functional projects, ensuring clear communication and alignment among all stakeholders.
  • Performance Analysis: Track, measure, and report on content performance across channels, using insights to refine and optimize our content strategy.
  • Competitive Research: Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for content improvement and innovation.
  • Social Media Management: Collaborate with PR to publish B2B-focused content on our social platforms and analyze performance to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Vendor Management: Onboard and manage external vendors as required.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • A minimum of 3 years in copywriting, content marketing, or related roles, preferably in the tech or travel industry. B2B marketing experience is a strong plus.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with demonstrated ability to write high-quality, effective content in different formats.
  • Experience with content management systems, SEO, and website analytics tools (Google Analytics). Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience working with design teams to produce visually engaging content.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing and UX best practices.
  • Excellent project management, time management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong communication skills and a confident, persuasive writing style (please be prepared to share your own writing samples).
  • Familiarity with the tech and travel industries, with experience in the online travel agency sector being a plus.

Why Join Us

At Agoda, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our communication strategies and driving growth within the B2B marketing division. If you are an innovative thinker passionate about travel technology and have the skills to elevate our brand narrative, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.

Requirements

  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.

  • Hands-on experience in backend (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS) and optionally frontend development, with a track record of delivering scalable systems.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.

  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.
  • Experience guiding and leading teams to successful project deliveries within deadlines and budgets.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.

  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.
  • Skilled in managing disagreements constructively and promoting consensus through dialogue.
  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands-on levels, flexing between system design and stakeholder engagement as needed.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Process Stages

  • Assessment (skills mapping) — We use an evaluation tool to map your work style and how you align with our culture. This step helps us understand how your skills can enhance our solutions.
  • Technical Assessment — You’ll solve technical cases and discuss with our engineering team to explore decisions, strategies, and scalability.
  • Conversation with Leadership — Meet the squad leader to discuss challenges, daily activities, and alignment between goals, culture, and your career aspirations.
  • Offer — If we proceed, you will receive a detailed proposal with information about the role, benefits, and impact.

Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.

A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

O candidato ideal será responsável por fornecer liderança técnica, orientação e mentoria para a equipe, ao mesmo tempo em que colabora com gerentes de produto e outros stakeholders para definir a visão técnica e a arquitetura dos nossos sistemas.

Responsabilidades:

Liderança Técnica: Fornecer direção técnica e orientação para a equipe de desenvolvimento em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção.

Arquitetura de Soluções: Liderar o desenho e a definição da arquitetura de software, garantindo soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance.

Qualidade de Código: Estabelecer e promover as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo revisões de código (code reviews), testes automatizados e integração contínua.

Gestão de Projetos e Entregas: Colaborar no planejamento de sprints e no gerenciamento de tarefas, assegurando que os prazos e os objetivos técnicos dos projetos sejam cumpridos.

Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para os desenvolvedores, auxiliando no seu desenvolvimento profissional, tirando dúvidas técnicas e promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo.

Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Avaliar e selecionar as tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas mais adequadas para cada projeto.

Comunicação e Colaboração: Atuar como a ponte entre a equipe técnica e as áreas de negócio, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas claras.

Resolução de Problemas: Identificar e solucionar os desafios técnicos mais complexos do projeto, garantindo a estabilidade e a qualidade das entregas.

Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Sólida experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software e comprovada experiência em uma posição de liderança técnica ou como desenvolvedor sênior.

Experiência: Em metodologias ágeis, incluindo SCRUM, Kanban, LEAN ou SAFe.

title: Analista de Proteção de Dados Pleno
description:
A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

O Analista de Proteção de Dados Pleno tem como responsabilidade atuar na proteção de dados pessoais e sensíveis da organização, garantindo o atendimento às legislações vigentes (como LGPD e GDPR), suportando as iniciativas de governança de dados, gestão de acessos e mitigação de riscos relacionados ao uso, tratamento e compartilhamento de dados.

Main responsibilities

  • Mapeamento de Dados Pessoais: Apoiar os processos de identificação, classificação e inventário de dados pessoais em sistemas e bases corporativas;

  • Familiarity with REST and GraphQL APIs, caching (Redis, Varnish), and indexing (Elasticsearch).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools, Git, and deployment processes in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Comfortable working in Agile teams and using support ticketing systems like Jira or ServiceNow.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Reliable, responsive, and calm under pressure — especially when resolving time-sensitive incidents.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Mirakl or other marketplace platforms.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or PWA frameworks (Vue Storefront, Adobe PWA Studio).
  • Familiarity with server monitoring and log management tools.
  • Experience in supporting projects in production.

  • A career in the fast-paced world of retail eCommerce, digital marketplaces, and platform businesses.
  • A career with first movers who are deploying new business models and strategies worldwide.
  • A career in a flat management structure without a rigid hierarchy and bureaucracy.
  • A career in a culture that rewards creativity and innovation, risk-taking and teamwork.

Caring, Adaptable, Proactive Ownership, Empowering Clients

Hello talented professionals! We're currently looking to expand our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to join us by applying to this job posting. If you're passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you!

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

What you can expect

  • Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values.
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role.
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest

  • UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.
  • Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Use graphic design software to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.
  • Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.
  • User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and QA checks to ensure UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills

  • Strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography, and composition. Ability to create visually appealing and cohesive UI designs that enhance usability and aesthetics.
  • Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI.
  • User-Centered Design , knowledge of UX principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.
  • Best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Familiarity with mobile gaming industry and platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.
  • Creative thinking and a passion for pushing the boundaries of UI design in mobile games. Ability to solve design challenges, iterate on ideas, and adapt to feedback and changing project requirements.

Software Expertise

  • Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, InDesign
  • Unity and Unreal engines
  • GitHub/SourceTree/Fork/Perforce
  • Miro/Confluence/Basecamp
  • Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure RP, Marvel, Affinity Designer, Balsamiq, Principle and Framer are a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or Portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects

title: Fullstack Engineer- Contract
description:
Company Summary

Slang.ai is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang.ai , we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be

You'll join Slang's Engineering team as a Full Stack Software Engineer (contractor), working as part of a new Integrations pod focused on building seamless connections with third-party reservation systems. Your work will enable restaurants to connect their existing reservation platforms with Slang's conversational AI solutions, creating a unified experience for booking reservations and events. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time developing robust backend services in Kotlin to handle these integrations, with the remaining 30% contributing to React/TypeScript frontend features for configuration and monitoring. Your work will directly impact thousands of restaurant interactions daily, helping businesses automate bookings and improve customer service through natural conversation while leveraging their existing technology investments.

You'll report to the Engineering Manager, collaborating closely with product managers, conversation designers, and fellow engineers. The role requires 4+ hours of daily overlap with EST (12:30-4:30 PM ET), with attendance at key ceremonies including daily standups at 1:00 PM ET, bi-weekly cycle planning, and weekly Show & Tell sessions. As a remote contractor, you'll use modern collaboration tools like Slack, GitHub, and video conferencing to stay connected with the team. Once ramped up, you'll have opportunities to mentor junior and other mid-level engineers through code reviews and pair programming sessions.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow

Our engineering culture emphasizes pragmatic solutions, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving. We believe in domain-driven design, comprehensive testing, and building systems that gracefully handle the complexities of real-world restaurant operations. You'll work alongside engineers who are passionate about creating reliable, scalable conversational experiences and who regularly share knowledge through Show & Tell sessions and detailed technical documentation. As a contractor, you'll gain exposure to cutting-edge conversational AI technologies, telephony systems at scale, and modern cloud-native architectures. You'll deepen your expertise in Kotlin and functional programming while working with production systems handling real-time voice interactions. The cross-functional nature of the role—spanning backend, frontend, and AI integrations—will accelerate your growth toward senior engineering roles. You'll learn from experienced engineers while contributing your own perspectives to architectural decisions and technical standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Design and implement scalable Kotlin backend services following domain-driven design principles, with comprehensive error handling and testing
  • Develop and maintain GraphQL APIs that efficiently serve both internal and external clients
  • Build React/TypeScript frontend components that provide intuitive interfaces for restaurant staff and customers
  • Create robust integrations with Twilio telephony services and Dialogflow conversational AI, handling edge cases and failure scenarios gracefully
  • Design efficient Firestore data models that balance performance, cost, and maintainability
  • Implement comprehensive observability including logging, metrics, tracing, and actionable alerting
  • Deliver production-ready code with appropriate test coverage (unit, integration, and end-to-end tests)
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating suggestions
  • Document technical decisions, API contracts, and system architecture clearly
  • Deploy containerized applications to Google Cloud Platform following cloud-native best practices
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to refine requirements and deliver features that meet business needs
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and help establish coding standards and best practices

What You Will Bring

  • 3-5 years of professional software development experience with full stack applications
  • Strong proficiency in at least one JVM language (Kotlin, Java, or Scala) with understanding of functional programming concepts
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs
  • Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript for frontend development
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases and data modeling concepts
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Strong understanding of software testing practices and test-driven development
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across the full stack
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration
  • Available for 40 hours per week with 4+ hours daily overlap with EST

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Kotlin specifically and its idioms
  • Familiarity with GraphQL schema design and implementation
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform services (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub)
  • Knowledge of telephony systems (Twilio or similar) and webhook integrations
  • Experience with conversational AI platforms (Dialogflow, Lex, or similar)
  • Infrastructure as code experience with Terraform
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems patterns
  • Experience with observability tools and practices (structured logging, distributed tracing)
  • Previous experience in a contractor or consultant role
  • Interest in restaurant/hospitality technology domain

Core Responsibilities & Technical Standards

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and the JVM ecosystem (primary focus)
  • Develop GraphQL queries and mutations for client-server communication
  • Contribute to React frontend components and features as needed
  • Create modular, testable code following domain-driven design principles
  • Implement proper error handling, logging, and graceful degradation patterns
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests across the stack
  • Data Modeling and Storage
  • Design and implement Firestore data models that optimize for performance and maintainability
  • Create efficient data access patterns and queries
  • Implement data migration scripts and schema evolution strategies
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across distributed systems
  • Design GraphQL schemas that effectively represent domain models
  • Telephony and AI Integrations
  • Develop and maintain integrations with Twilio for voice and messaging capabilities
  • Implement Dialogflow conversational flows and webhook handlers
  • Create fault-tolerant communication between telephony providers and internal services
  • Handle edge cases and error scenarios in telephony workflows
  • Implement retry logic and circuit breaker patterns for external service calls
  • Frontend Development (as needed)
  • Implement React components using TypeScript
  • Integrate frontend with GraphQL APIs
  • Ensure responsive and accessible UI implementations
  • Write unit tests for React components
  • Collaborate with product team on user experience improvements
  • Cloud Services Integration
  • Develop containerized applications using Docker
  • Deploy and manage services on Google Cloud Platform
  • Ensure services follow cloud-native best practices for scalability and resilience
  • Integrate with GCP services (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, etc.) as required
  • Provision new infrastructure using Terraform as needed under the guidance of platform engineering
  • Observability and Monitoring
  • Implement comprehensive logging, metrics, and tracing
  • Create dashboards and alerts for service health monitoring
  • Develop diagnostic tools to aid in troubleshooting production issues
  • Ensure all services provide actionable insights into their behavior and performance

Technical Standards

  • Follow Kotlin idioms and best practices for backend development
  • Use TypeScript effectively with proper type safety for frontend work
  • Use dependency injection and maintain loose coupling
  • Write self-documenting code with meaningful variable and function names
  • Maintain consistent code formatting using agreed-upon linter

$6,000 - $6,500 a month

How Work Affects My Life

title: Senior Payroll & Tax Analyst
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Senior Payroll & Tax Analyst who will play a critical role in ensuring compliance, accuracy, and scalability across TRM’s payroll and tax infrastructure. As a fully remote, global company operating across multiple U.S. states and international jurisdictions, TRM faces complex payroll tax requirements that demand specialized expertise. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient, compliant processes that reduce risk and improve employee experience.

The Payroll & Tax Operations Specialist will join a high-performing Finance team that leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll work cross-functionally with HR, Finance, and Legal to deliver timely and accurate payroll, resolve tax issues, and implement process improvements that scale with TRM’s growth. This role is critical to maintaining compliance, ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time, and supporting broader corporate tax needs.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payroll operations end-to-end : Review and finalize payroll within 48 hours of cut-off, consistently achieving <1% error rates and 100% on-time processing across all pay cycles.
  • Ensure tax compliance : Manage multi-state payroll tax filings, resolve tax notices within 5 business days, and complete monthly reconciliations with no material variances to support Finance’s accurate reporting.
  • Support corporate tax activities : Contribute to broader tax compliance needs, including preparation of tax provisions and support for federal, state, and indirect tax obligations.
  • Drive process and automation improvements : Identify and implement workflows or automation enhancements annually to reduce manual work, minimize compliance risk, and improve scalability.
  • Partner cross-functionally : Provide timely, accurate data and reporting to HR and Finance (e.g., headcount reports, tax provisions, employee tax queries) while maintaining strong relationships and high partner satisfaction.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years of payroll operations and payroll tax compliance experience, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth, multi-state environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state payroll tax regulations; exposure to indirect taxes (e.g., sales tax) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with payroll systems and tax platforms; ability to support a system transition (we will be moving off IBP) and optimize workflows for scalability.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent payroll/tax priorities without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience performing reconciliations and identifying root causes of variances.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and resolves issues quickly.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we\'re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description—we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

Você fará a ponte entre requisitos de negócios e soluções técnicas, facilitando discussões técnicas e garantindo alinhamento com os resultados do cliente. Aplicando frameworks AWS como Well-Architected e Cloud Adoption Framework, enquanto demonstra credibilidade técnica entre diversos stakeholders, você transformará as necessidades do cliente em requisitos técnicos claros, decomporá problemas complexos e tomará decisões informadas considerando desempenho, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto nos negócios.

Possuindo forte experiência em tecnologia e gerenciamento de programas/projetos, você validará soluções técnicas em relação aos objetivos de negócio, reconhecerá quando avaliações técnicas adicionais são necessárias e gerenciará riscos técnicos. Espera-se que você obtenha e mantenha certificações AWS relevantes, desenvolva expertise em domínios específicos e comunique efetivamente conceitos técnicos para públicos técnicos e de negócios. À medida que progredir, você liderará projetos técnicos cada vez mais complexos, moldará estratégias técnicas entre organizações e estabelecerá melhores práticas em seu domínio. Nesta função, você aplicará suas capacidades de gestão e liderança para executar com sucesso planos de projeto, identificar e gerenciar riscos proativamente, resolver problemas, escalar quando apropriado e conduzir projetos a uma conclusão bem-sucedida, superando as expectativas do cliente.

A organização AWS Professional Services é uma equipe global de especialistas que ajudam os clientes a alcançar seus resultados de negócios desejados ao usar a AWS Cloud. Trabalhamos em conjunto com as equipes dos clientes e a AWS Partner Network (APN) para executar iniciativas empresariais de computação em nuvem. Também oferecemos orientação focada através de nossas práticas especializadas globais, que abrangem uma variedade de soluções, tecnologias e indústrias.

Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador(a) e ele(a) lhe conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”.
Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de D&I, atuando como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o primeiro dia.

Key job responsibilities

Como um gerente de programa/projeto de tecnologia experiente, você será responsável por:

  • Liderar e gerenciar projetos complexos de migração e implementação em nuvem
  • Aproveitar o conhecimento abrangente dos serviços AWS, arquiteturas e melhores práticas para orientar decisões técnicas e planejamento estratégico
  • Fazer a ponte entre requisitos de negócios e soluções técnicas, facilitando discussões de engenharia e garantindo alinhamento com resultados de negócios do cliente
  • Transformar necessidades do cliente em requisitos técnicos claros e mapeá-los para resultados de negócios
  • Decompor problemas técnicos complexos em soluções acionáveis e entregáveis
  • Contribuir para documentação técnica e definir padrões de documentação

About the team

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?: AWS is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from startups to Global 500 companies trust our suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture: Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We’re continually raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. You’ll find knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources to help you develop.

Work/Life Balance: We value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility in our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Process Automation
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Software Engineer, AI Process Automation to join our cutting edge AI & Automation team. In this role, you\'ll be the architect of our internal operational efficiency. Your primary mission is to identify, design, and deploy intelligent automation solutions that eliminate manual work, accelerate our data analysis, and empower our teams to focus on high-value challenges in the blockchain intelligence landscape.

This is a high-impact position with a clear and ambitious goal: within your first six months, you will be expected to deliver a portfolio of automations that saves a cumulative 80 hours of manual work per week across the company.

You\'ll leverage a modern toolkit including low-code platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier), custom code (JavaScript/Python), and AI models to tackle complex challenges. You will work directly with every team within the business, making our entire organization faster, smarter, and more secure.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead the discovery and analysis of business processes across all departments, identifying high-impact opportunities for automation and process re-engineering.
  • Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable automation workflows using platforms like n8n and Make, seamlessly extending their capabilities with custom JavaScript or Python when necessary.
  • Develop complex integrations between our core systems and third-party applications, including Jira, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Notion, Google Workspace, and our core data warehouse in BigQuery.
  • Pioneer the use of AI within our automations, building agentic workflows, leveraging LLMs for tasks like content summarization and data reconciliation, and implementing robust evaluation frameworks to measure model effectiveness.
  • Serve as the platform owner for our core AI and automation tech stack. This includes working alongside our Infrastructure teams managing the environments to ensure reliability and performance, as well as enhancing the user experience (UX) to empower other teams to build their own automations effectively.
  • Champion and enforce stringent security standards in all automations, ensuring the secure handling of sensitive data and implementing best practices for encryption, access control, and secure API usage in partnership with our security team.
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of automation projects from initial ideation and requirements gathering with stakeholders to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

What we\'re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in process automation, software development, or a similar role, with a strong portfolio of successfully deployed projects that delivered measurable business value.
  • Expert-level proficiency with at least one enterprise-grade low-code/no-code automation platform (e.g., n8n, Make). You should know its limitations and have a strong understanding of best practices to implement when working with the tools.
  • Strong scripting and development skills in JavaScript (Node.js) and/or Python, used to write custom logic, transform data, and interact with APIs.
  • Proficiency in software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices. You should be comfortable using version control (Git) for your projects and understand the principles of automated testing and CI/CD to build robust and maintainable automations.
  • Deep expertise in business process mapping, requirements gathering, and designing scalable, fault-tolerant workflow architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting complex, multi-system API integrations and solving the challenges that come with them.
  • A security-first mindset with proven experience building systems that handle sensitive or confidential data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive and autonomous work ethic. You can take a high-level goal, break it down into actionable steps, and drive it to completion.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building agentic workflows or integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) for tasks like NLP, data extraction, or content generation.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and services (GCP, AWS).
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts and writing complex SQL queries (especially for BigQuery).
  • A genuine interest in the blockchain, cryptocurrency, or FinTech space.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you\'ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we\'re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We\’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We\u2019re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don\u2019t worry if your experience doesn\'t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you\u2019re excited about TRM\u2019s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement. Privacy Policy

By submitting your application, you are agreeing to allow TRM to process your personal information in accordance with the TRM Privacy Policy

description:
O Kyte é um sistema de gestão desenvolvido especialmente para o micro comércio, otimizando a forma de vender, gerenciar e se relacionar com os clientes. Criado por uma equipe que entende profundamente a realidade dos pequenos negócios, o Kyte foi projetado do zero para atender às necessidades do empreendedor moderno, com um foco no futuro, onde o celular se torna o centro das operações e transforma as interações entre lojas e consumidores. Temos mais de 60.000 negócios usando o Kyte para fazer seus negócios darem certo.

A Kyte é uma startup que nasceu em Florianópolis, mas atualmente está com o time todo distribuído por todo Brasil. Nossa ambição é atender a um número crescente de clientes em todo o mundo, gerando valor e qualidade ao seu negócio. Ficamos encantados com as dezenas de depoimentos que recebemos todos os dias sobre como 'salvamos' seus negócios. Estamos sempre pensando em melhorar, seja um produto, negócio, processo ou nós mesmos. Acreditamos que a satisfação no trabalho é um grande desafio com as ferramentas certas e a visibilidade que temos vindo a desenvolver. Somos ágeis e gostamos de uma comunicação pragmática e rica, mas sempre com muito respeito. Sabemos que grandes coisas só podem ser alcançadas com equipes incríveis. Nosso código de cultura completo está disponível neste link.

O que buscamos

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor Python Backend: Especialista IA para fortalecer nossa capacidade de inovação e aprimorar a integração de Inteligência Artificial em nossos produtos e serviços.

Procuramos um(a) profissional estratégico(a), independente e proativo(a), que vá além da implementação técnica, contribuindo com soluções inovadoras baseadas em pesquisa, análise de desempenho e tendências emergentes.

Essa pessoa será responsável por projetar e otimizar modelos de IA, integrar APIs de LLMs e desenvolver soluções avançadas que aprimorem a experiência do usuário e impulsionem a eficiência dos processos.

Seu papel no time

Como Desenvolvedor Python Backend: Especialista IA ( Sênior ), você será peça-chave no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de soluções baseadas em IA. Seu desafio será criar diretrizes estratégicas, definir arquiteturas eficientes e garantir que cada solução agregue valor real e mensurável ao negócio.

No seu dia a dia, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning e LLMs para aplicações práticas;

  • Criar e integrar APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, entre outros);

  • Trabalhar com modelos open-source (como Llama, Mistral, Falcon) e implementar fine-tuning para personalização de modelos;

  • Aplicar técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para consultas em bases de conhecimento;

  • Trabalhar com engenharia de prompts para otimização de interações com modelos de linguagem;

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis usando Python como linguagem principal, além de TypeScript/JavaScript para integrações e backend;

  • Utilizar frameworks para construir APIs eficientes, validar dados e desenvolver modelos de machine learning com:FastAPI, Pydantic, PyTorch ou TensorFlow;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas para desenvolver, monitorar e escalar aplicações de IA de forma estruturada como:LangChain / LangGraph, W&B, Modal e Hugging Face;

  • Implementar soluções em bancos de dados SQL/NoSQL, MongoDB e vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate, Mongo);

  • Analisar métricas de desempenho e aplicar insights para aprimoramento contínuo das soluções de IA;

  • Estar sempre atualizado(a) sobre tendências em IA, NLP, Machine Learning e otimização de modelos.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida em Python e TypeScript/JavaScript para integração de soluções;

  • Profundo conhecimento em Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs) e Machine Learning;

  • Habilidade em engenharia de prompts e fine-tuning de modelos para casos de uso específicos;

  • Capacidade de interpretar insights baseados em dados para aprimorar modelos e estratégias;

  • Mentalidade autodidata—você toma iniciativa, aprende rápido e executa com independência;

  • Experiência prática na implementação de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);

  • Conhecimento em frameworks e ferramentas como PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, FastAPI e Pydantic.

Diferenciais que vão destacar sua candidatura:

  • Experiência com implementação de IA em produtos e serviços existentes;

  • Histórico de sucesso na criação e escalabilidade de soluções baseadas em IA.

description:
Executivo de Contas (Engenharia Civil e Arquitetura)

A indústria da construção civil é a segunda menos digitalizada globalmente, e a Vobi nasceu para revolucioná-la! Nossa missão é empoderar profissionais e pequenos negócios deste setor, conectando toda a indústria em uma única plataforma e fornecendo-lhes todas as ferramentas necessárias para conseguirem entregar projetos e obras incríveis, de maneira transparente, simples e colaborativa.

Estamos em busca de pessoas recém formadas, com muita proatividade, responsabilidade, com espírito de dono e muita vontade de aprender para agregar o nosso time de Vendas, atuando como Inside Sales e nos ajudando a encantar e converter potenciais clientes, além de melhorar continuamente nossos processos.

Se você gosta de desafios e está a fim de sacudir uma indústria tradicional e arcaica por completo, venha falar conosco.

Principais atividades desta posição

  1. Administrar e acompanhar leads dentro do funil de vendas, entendendo as necessidades e fazendo o acompanhamento da performance;
  2. Realizar demonstrações e acompanhamento das propostas;
  3. Auxiliar o time de Marketing e Produto, colhendo feedbacks dos potenciais clientes e buscando alternativas para aumentar a conversão;
  4. Atender potenciais clientes através dos nossos canais de atendimento (WhatsApp, e-mail, chat, entre outros) e fazer follow-ups para convertê-los;
  5. Trabalhar em conjunto com o time para alcançar as metas de vendas e faturamento da empresa.

O que esperamos de você

  1. Graduação em Engenharia Civil ou Arquitetura;
  2. Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  3. Perfil investigativo e curioso para solucionar problemas;
  4. Habilidade de organização e gestão de tempo;
  5. Experiência na área de vendas;
  6. Saber trabalhar bem em equipe, e ser flexível para mudanças dentro da função;
  7. Experiência com SaaS (diferencial);
  8. Ter experiência atuando na área da construção civil (desejável).

Porque você vai amar trabalhar com a gente

  1. Remuneração competitiva em relação ao mercado;
  2. Possibilidade de participação societária;
  3. Ambiente descontraído, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento e suporte para desenvolver sua carreira;
  4. Happy Hours mensais, e confraternizações presenciais semestrais;
  5. Day off de aniversário;
  6. Trabalho remoto e flexível;
  7. Liberdade para propor novas ideias e assumir grandes responsabilidades.

Criada por ex-sócios da MAR Ventures - Venture builder com negócios avaliados em mais de R$ 1 bilhão - e investida pela Y Combinator, a Vobi está transformando a indústria da construção civil através da tecnologia!

A Vobi é uma plataforma SaaS de gestão para pequenas e médias empresas do setor, como escritórios de arquitetura, empresas de engenharia e construtoras. Nós os ajudamos a gerenciar melhor os seus projetos, obras e negócio, conectando e fornecendo todas as ferramentas necessárias e eliminando tarefas administrativas e manuais para que se concentrem no crescimento dos seus negócios.

Através plataforma, profissionais e seus clientes conseguem colaborar, planejar, criar orçamentos, realizar compras e fazer pagamentos a fornecedores de produtos ou serviços, em um único local.

Anualmente, mais de R$ 4 bilhões em obras são gerenciadas através da Vobi, e nossa presença já se estende por todos os estados do Brasil.

Pronto(a) para transformar uma indústria extremamente tradicional?!

At Caylent, a Senior Machine Learning Engineer works as an integral part of a cross-functional delivery team to design and document machine learning solutions on the AWS cloud for our customers. 1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants
